name: BE
context: Belgium electricity market dataset with hourly electricity price and exogenous load and generation measurements spanning 6 years (2011-01-09 to 2016-12-31).

endo.name: price
endo.description: Day-ahead hourly electricity price in the Belgian electricity market (EUR/MWh).

exo.name: system_load_forecast
exo.description: Forecasted total electricity system load in MW for Belgium, reflecting anticipated national electricity demand.

exo.name: generation_forecast
exo.description: Forecasted total power generation in MW for France, capturing cross-border supply conditions that influence Belgian electricity prices.
